verdict.text: The change adds ADR 0030 and links it from the index, the log and the summary.
Its claims match the repo, and the summary edits keep their meaning while staying under 500 words.
I read the staged diff in full.
tests/test_starter.py lists apm_modules/x in IGNORED and asserts git check-ignore reports every IGNORED path.
The repo's own .gitignore ignores apm_modules/ and .claude/settings.local.json.
starter/justfile.jinja has bootstrap depend on install, and install runs apm install and then kmctl plugin patch, as the ADR says.
The deployed files the ADR names (.agents/hooks.json, .agents/mcp_config.json, opencode.json) are the ones src/kmctl/antigravity.py and opencode.py handle.
In the worktree, uv run kmctl check passed ("all checks passed"), and row r1's command exited 0.
Row r1's grep checks fails_when directly.
Row r2 is kmctl check itself.
The caller asked me not to run the full suite to save disk, so I did not re-run loopctl gate stamp.
For this docs-only change the implementer's green stamp stands.
The summary drops "new" from "starts new projects", which loses nothing that matters.
